steps: 1. In the Official Realm, record the career's melee/ranged weapons, outfit, hat, portrait frame, victory pose and weapon illusion.
2. With Cosmetics Tweaker disabled, enter the Modded Realm, open **Mod Tweaker > Tweaker: GUI**, and enable **Use non-modded loadouts**.
3. Change each cosmetic category, close and reopen Equipment, then exit normally and relaunch into the Modded Realm.
4. Confirm those cosmetics persisted separately while protected melee/ranged weapons still match the official baseline.
5. Return to the Official Realm and compare every recorded selection without modifying it.

6. Relaunch with public Cosmetics Tweaker enabled alongside public GUI. Repeat cosmetic changes and Apply through its normal cosmetics UI, including weapon illusion, hat, skin and frame; repeat the reopen/restart and Official visual comparisons. Confirm gameplay gear stays protected and the cosmetic selections neither snap back nor become duplicate writers.
assertions: In both standalone-GUI and Cosmetics composition launches, cosmetics remain editable and persistent only on the modded side while protected gameplay gear and every official selection remain unchanged. No snap-back, repeated blocked/equip loop, error or crash occurs.
Readonly mode: set hat, skin, frame, pose, illusion; reopen and relaunch; assert overlay persists, weapon slots equal official snapshot, official mirror rows identical.
